Coram : H.S. BEDI*, J.M. PANCHAL
Penal Code, 1860: A B ss. 304(part 11)134 and 324134 - Custodial death - Burden c of proof - Five persons beaten up by police officials in police station - Two of them died and three sustained injuries - HELD: By ocular version and medical evidence, prosecution has proved its case against accused the deceased were brought alive to the police 0 station but were produced dead before medical officer, it is for the accused-police officials to explain the circumstance in which the victims died - The accused pleaded a false defence which reinforces their guilt -Conviction and sentence upheld -
Decision Date : 03-12-2009 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 382/2003 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
